rows.what_the_ink_shows: The supplied scan is upside down. Viewed after a 180-degree rotation, it is a black typescript with handwritten mathematical symbols and page number 35. It displays psi(S,Z,Y,X)=xi eta phi(Z,Y), says psi is local and commutes with changements de base, and treats a smooth pair (Z,X) of codimension c>1 using a triple (Z,Y,X), independence of Y, and descent. These visible features positively agree with the row’s local description of a page-35 draft involving smooth pairs and base change. The original scan also has the separate handwritten sheet number 61 in the opposite orientation. Evidence: crops/8_scan062_L743_page35_local_construction.jpg, personally inspected.
